Lena: quick note: edge quickstart failed for me on wrangler - type errors + weird retry header duplication.
Omar: hmm, details? stack or small repro?
Lena: using the TS quickstart. Importing default: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'`. Build succeeds, but running under wrangler dev I get a runtime `slice` error inside tokenizer.
Priya: that usually means an import shape mismatch (interop default wrapping). Did you try the explicit edge entry? `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk/edge'`
Lena: yep switching to `/edge` removed the slice error. But retry flow still sends duplicated auth header on 2nd attempt: `Authorization: Bearer x,Bearer x`.
Omar: ah, headers coercion bug. Our retry middleware mutates headers with `.set()` assuming a Headers object. If a bundler or runtime passes a plain object it falls back and ends up concatenating strings.
Priya: easy fix: coerce to Headers early in middleware: `if (!(req.headers instanceof Headers)) req.headers = new Headers(req.headers)`. Also tighten TS overloads so `headers` is required to be `Headers` for fetch-style clients.
Lena: can we also add a short note in the quickstart README to prefer the `/edge` entry for edge runtimes? Saved me 20 minutes.
Omar: agreed. I'll open a PR with: (1) header coercion, (2) TS type tweak/unit, (3) docs change.
ci-bot: CI started for redwood/edge-quickstart#421 - checks: build, types, wrangler-smoke.
Lena: thanks, will test the PR once CI passes.
